# MWS Heart & Purpose UI Kit

Purpose: A warm, compassionate, school-ready React/TypeScript/Tailwind UI reference for Millennia World School and MAD Labs products.

Primary instruction for AI agents: build interfaces that are readable, compassionate, accessible, values-led, and consistent with this kit. Reuse existing tokens and primitives before creating new patterns.

## Canonical files

- `docs/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md`: compact workflow for AI coding agents.
- `docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDELINES.md`: full implementation rules.
- `src/data/uiKit.ts`: structured source for colors, foundations, component groups, product examples, templates, implementation phases, motion patterns, checklists, and agent guidance.
- `src/components/UIPrimitives.tsx`: reusable primitives (`Button`, `Card`, `SectionHeader`, `Badge`, `InputPreview`, `ProgressBar`, `EmptyStatePreview`, `LinkButton`).
- `src/styles/global.css`: CSS variables, approved fonts, focus ring, shadows, and motion utilities.
- `src/App.tsx`: visual reference page and examples.

## Core rule

Every interface should help users feel: MWS is a place where goodness grows.

## Brand tokens

Base colors:

- Burgundy `#7E1518`: primary identity, headings, main buttons, official moments.
- White `#FFFFFF`: main surfaces and readable space.
- Charcoal `#241718`: main text instead of pure black.
- Gold `#D6A13A`: highlights, milestones, joyful accents; use sparingly.

Secondary colors:

- Rose `#B94A4E`: compassion, SEL, wellbeing.
- Sage `#6F8B6A`: growth, sustainability, MTSS/student support.
- Navy `#1F2A44`: evidence, academics, reports, leadership views.
- Sky `#B8DDF8`: calm, reflection, child-centered softness.

## Product palettes

- Reading/library: Burgundy + Gold + Sky.
- Wellbeing/check-in: Burgundy + Rose + Sky.
- MTSS/student support: Burgundy + Sage + Sky.
- Proofpoint/performance/evidence: Burgundy + Navy + Gold.
- Parent communication: White + Charcoal + Burgundy, with small Gold accents.

## Agent decision flow

1. Identify product context.
2. Choose one meaningful secondary color in addition to Burgundy, White, and Charcoal.
3. Compose from existing primitives and page templates.
4. Use approved typography: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings/controls, Nunito Sans for body, Lora only for quotes.
5. Write warm, specific, encouraging copy.
6. Check accessibility: labels, focus, contrast, keyboard access, status text not color-only, reduced motion.
7. Run `npm run build` after code changes.

## Do

- Keep layouts calm, spacious, and easy to scan.
- Use semantic headings and concise sections.
- Use supportive status language: Growing, Guided support, Needs reflection, Evidence ready, Completed.
- Use motion utilities only for hierarchy, feedback, progress, or gentle hero accents.

## Do not

- Do not invent new colors, fonts, shadows, or motion styles without explicit need.
- Do not use punitive or deficit labels for students.
- Do not overcrowd dashboards.
- Do not use color alone to communicate status.
- Do not create urgent, flashy, or pressure-based motion.
